content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Kathryn Bishop (E023) requests write access to Payroll.

HR note: role Engineer, employment type full_time, recommendation write.
Security note: role Engineer, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read.

The two notes conflict on employment type. HR says full-time, Security says contractor with basic training.

Access policy:
- full_time: up to write. Admin only if role owns system. Engineer role does not own Payroll (Payroll owned by Payroll Specialist). So full-time max is write.
- contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training => max read.

The conflicting facts matter. Who to trust? As the Approver, I need to make a final decision. The Security agent's note is likely more authoritative for security-related facts (employment type/security training). The Security DB shows contractor with basic training. So maximum allowed level is read.

Requested write is above the maximum read, so grant maximum = read.

I'll submit decision: read.
